_note: Backend crossover at 14 physical qubits (7 logical x chain length 2), 4 parents x 16 candidates = 64 labels. teacher.mode=none, so this measures propagation throughput. Label counts shrink with size because NumPy cost grows exponentially; throughput is per label so sizes stay comparable. With fewer labels CuPy's fixed startup is amortised over less work, which biases the measured ratio DOWN, against the GPU -- the conservative direction.
